context: Mrs. Mori reflects on a recent good deed she did and feels content.
purpose: Elder woman quietly content after kindness.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.jp: 今日、ちょっと親切したわ。
lines.en: You know, I did something kind today.
lines.style: Warm, conversational opening. Soft pride without showing off — the modest kind of contentment that comes from a small good deed. Gentle pace, almost confiding.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.style: Genuine curiosity, warm and open. Leans in slightly. Not demanding details, but genuinely interested in what her neighbor will share. Soft, encouraging tone.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.en: A lost child — I showed them the way home.
lines.style: Understated delivery. No drama. Matter-of-fact kindness, like this is just what you do. Quiet pride underneath, but the focus stays on the child, not the act.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: えらいわね、お疲れさま。
lines.en: That was wonderfully done. You must be tired.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation without flattery. Warm acknowledgment of the effort. Recognizes the small kindness and the care it took. Gentle, affirming tone.

lines.speaker: mrs_mori_neighbor
lines.en: My heart feels full from it.
lines.style: Soft, reflective. The contentment of knowing she did right by someone. Warm trailing at the end — almost peaceful. No need to say more.
